versions.description_html:
Learn how Power Platform solutions work. Master managed and unmanaged modes, environment deployment, publishers, prefixes, and application lifecycle management.

The app you spent months building can disappear the moment someone uninstalls the wrong thing. That happens when nothing is holding the app's pieces together, so one cleanup can take the whole thing with it.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a Solution Actually Is
  • Managed and Unmanaged: The Two Modes
  • Publishers and Prefixes
  • Moving Your App Between Environments
  • Solution Layers
  • Dependencies: Why You Sometimes Can't Remove Things
  • ALM Best Practices for Beginners
  • A Quick Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Architecting Power Platform for Complex Enterprise Solutions with Ian Tweedie [MVP]
  • Dataverse Business Skills for Scalable Power Platform Solutions
  • More Power Platform episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Power Platform: the most-listened episodes
